status: four appearance variants for user comparison

variants.name: 水滴手足
variants.hook: 圆润的小光滴手，微尖的水滴足；简洁、柔软。
variants.design: LIMB VARIATION A — SOFT DEWDROP LIMBS. Keep exactly two arms and two legs. Replace the current human-like fingered hands and toed feet with compact, smooth, gently swollen teardrop-shaped light extremities. Each SHORT upper limb ends in one small plump pear-shaped hand pad, with a tiny curved inner notch that suggests grasping, NO separated fingers, NO fingernails. Each VERY SHORT leg flows into one small rounded waterdrop foot with a gently tapered forward tip, NO distinct human heel, toes or shoe sole. These are solid cohesive ivory watercolor light forms, soft and friendly, not actual wet glass droplets. Short arms hang slightly out to each side, feet slightly apart and visibly planted on the ledge. Limb edges occasionally dissolve into one or two gold dust specks. Emphasize compact rounded silhouette, little dangling drop-like hands, and simple pointed-oval feet. No ribbon strips, split tendrils, petals or ghost tail.

No glossy plastic, no 3D render, no anime face, no detailed human anatomy, no horror.

variants.name: 光丝手足
variants.hook: 纤细光丝连接身体，末端轻轻分叉；轻盈、灵动。
variants.design: LIMB VARIATION B — SLENDER LIGHT-FILAMENT LIMBS. Keep exactly two arms and two legs. Replace all four humanlike limbs with SHORT, slender gently curved streams of condensed light. Their width is about half that of the source's limbs, but the limbs remain attached, opaque enough to read, and anatomically clear. Each arm ends in a tiny fork of TWO short curved luminous tips suggesting a spirit's pincer-like grasp, NOT human fingers, NOT claws; the fork is rounded and soft, each tip only a very short part of the hand. Each leg ends in two very short forward-curled light tips touching the ledge like a delicate spirit foot, not a long tentacle. All appendages are still short within the SAME two-head-tall chibi proportions. No long arms, no extended legs, no octopus silhouette, no spiky nails. Let the tips gradually become translucent ivory-gold watercolor strokes with a couple of fine dust specks. Show the two slim arms slightly away from the torso and both separate feet planted. Compact torso unchanged, distinctive fine curved light strokes at the extremities. No plump mitten hands, no petal fins, no tail.

variants.name: 光瓣手足
variants.hook: 半透明光瓣构成扁平手足；舒展、童话感强。
variants.design: LIMB VARIATION C — LUMINOUS PETAL LIMBS. Keep exactly two arms and two legs. Replace the humanlike hands and feet with SHORT, softly flattened translucent light membranes shaped like broad rounded flower petals, made of light rather than plants. Each short arm ends in a broad asymmetrical petal-shaped little hand-fin with ONE shallow cleft at the inner edge, no separated human fingers. These hand-fins are visibly wider and flatter than the arms and angle slightly out, not actual wings. Each very short leg ends in one flattened flaring petal-shaped foot, with a round broad fore-edge and narrowing connection at the ankle, planted on the ledge, no human toes. Two or three overlapping translucent watercolor bands subtly reveal the petal construction, but NO leaf veins, NO green plant material, NO actual flowers, NO insect wings. Hands and feet should have a broad flat scalloped silhouette clearly distinct from round drops or narrow filaments. Preserve the tiny pear torso and big rounded stardust head unchanged. Small ivory-blue and warm-gold luminous membranes, gentle curve, short and cute, no tail.

variants.name: 小幽灵拖尾
variants.hook: 双腿合为一条柔弯光尾，搭配短小光鳍手臂。
variants.design: LIMB VARIATION D — LEGLESS LITTLE GHOST. Completely REMOVE BOTH LEGS AND BOTH FEET. No legs, knees, foot bumps, toes, two-pronged lower silhouette, or residual soles may remain. The same small pear-shaped torso flows seamlessly downward into ONE single short curving ghost-like light tail. The tail tapers gently to one soft point that hooks slightly toward the left and dissolves into a few tiny gold stardust flecks. Give the lower silhouette a clear S-like curved end with no split, no fishtail and no mermaid fins. Keep the belly compact and cute, chest core still visible, all beneath the EXACT same much larger rounded head and stardust tuft. Keep TWO short arms, but change their ends into simple small translucent rounded light fins, no individual human fingers. The spirit hovers just above the mossy stone ledge with a small soft shadow and a clearly visible gap beneath the tail. The body is light itself, NOT a sheet ghost wearing cloth. Very friendly, slightly shy, softly glowing. Keep total compact chibi scale; do not stretch the tail into a long streamer. Preserve the eyes and tiny mouth, no scary grin. This is one protagonist, not a main figure plus a separate floating light form.
